headers.//: The pages carry the version queries that point at everything else, so they must never be served from a stale cache.

Hosting defaults these to max-age=3600. Nothing here is content-hashed, and the ES modules import each other directly, so a version query on the HTML tag cannot reach assets/js/data.js and friends. That is how a browser ended up holding the old dark core.css alongside the new light admin.css and rendering white on white. no-cache still caches -- it just forces a revalidate, so the usual answer is a 304 and the stale-mixture failure cannot happen again.
Artwork filenames are stable and the bytes never change under them.
